Case ID: 1176
Case Type: Complaint
Date: 2025-04-06
Handled By: Customer Support - Isaac Moreno
Customer or Requestor: Paula Knight
Title: Escalation over repeated order cancellation on limited-release item

Issue Description
Customer complained after two consecutive attempts to purchase a limited-release item were canceled, alleging the company was overselling inventory during launches.

Steps Taken
- Reviewed both order attempts and confirmed inventory reserved at checkout was later released during anti-fraud review timeout.
- Checked whether the customer's payment method or address triggered any unusual fraud signals and found none.
- Escalated to Operations and Fraud to confirm the cancellation root cause before responding.
- Reviewed whether any manual reorder path or priority restock notification could be offered.

Resolution
Provided a clear explanation, refunded both holds promptly, and offered priority notification for the next restock because the cancellations were caused by an internal reservation defect rather than customer risk.

Follow-Up
Operations opened a defect ticket for the launch inventory reservation timeout behavior.

Reference Documents
- Complaint Escalation Playbook v1
- Order Cancellation Playbook v1
